# The Webhook Gets Through

Version 3.1.1 fixes the webhook: for most ski resorts it sent nothing at all.

## Fixes

- **The webhook sends again for resorts with a season.** Resorts that publish their winter or summer season dates could not be sent to the webhook, because the dates were not plain text. The request failed, an error ended up in the log, and your webhook received nothing. The season dates now arrive as text such as `2026-12-05`, and every other value is unchanged. _[#56]_
- **Two setup dialogs no longer mix their answers.** If you added two resorts at the same time, the second dialog could pick up the language or country chosen in the first. Each dialog now keeps its own answers. _[#53]_
- **Libraries in step with Home Assistant.** The integration now asks for the versions of beautifulsoup4 and lxml that Home Assistant itself ships, so installing it no longer tries to replace them.

Nothing to change after updating.
